# NawmeEssences

> NawmeEssences is a Dhaka-based perfume decant business in Bangladesh founded by Arman Hossain Nawmee. The business offers authentic perfume decants from a personal collection of 90+ fragrances across 35+ brands, available in 3ml, 5ml, 10ml, 15ml, and 30ml sizes, with delivery throughout Bangladesh.

## Entity

- Business name: NawmeEssences
- Business type: Perfume decant business
- Founder: Arman Hossain Nawmee
- Primary website: https://nawmeessences.com/
- Location: Dhaka, Bangladesh
- Pickup locations: Aftabnagar, Banasree, NSU
- Primary offering: Authentic perfume decants
- Catalogue: 90+ fragrances
- Brands: 35+ brands
- Available sizes: 3ml, 5ml, 10ml, 15ml, 30ml
- Delivery: Nationwide across Bangladesh

## About NawmeEssences

NawmeEssences is a personal fragrance decant business based in Dhaka, Bangladesh and founded by Arman Hossain Nawmee, a CSE student and fragrance enthusiast.

Fragrance decants are prepared directly from authentic personal fragrance bottles using a syringe for accurate measurement. No adulteration is added to the fragrance.

## Products & Catalogue

### Regular Collection

NawmeEssences offers 90+ regular perfume decants across 35+ brands.

Brands include:

Afnan, Al Haramain, Alfred Dunhill, Amouage, Armaf, Azzaro, Bentley, Bvlgari, Davidoff, Dior, Dolce & Gabbana, French Avenue, Giorgio Armani, Gucci, Gulf Orchid, Hugo Boss, Jean Paul Gaultier, Lalique, Lattafa, Mancera, Mercedes Benz, Nautica, Prada, Rasasi, Rayhaan, Riiffs, Yves Saint Laurent, and more.

### Decant Sizes

- 3ml
- 5ml
- 10ml
- 15ml
- 30ml

### Exclusive Collection

The Exclusive Collection contains selected rare, discontinued, and vintage fragrances.

Examples include:

- Jacques Bogart Silver Scent Pure
- Alfred Dunhill Icon
- Dolce & Gabbana Light Blue Eau Intense
- JPG Le Male In The Navy (2018 formulation)
- JPG Ultra Male (old formulation)
- Giorgio Armani Acqua di Gio Profondo (2020)
- Giorgio Armani Acqua di Gio Absolu
- Dior Homme Sport (2017 formulation)
- Dior Homme Intense
- Gucci Guilty Elixir

Payment: 100% advance payment is required for exclusive items.

| Size | Starting price |
|---|---:|

| 15ml | ৳560 |
| 30ml | ৳1,090 |

## Delivery

- Within Dhaka: ৳70
- Dhaka suburbs: ৳90
- Outside Dhaka / nationwide: ৳120

## Payment Policy

- Minimum advance payment: delivery charge
- Orders above ৳2,000: 30% advance required
- Exclusive and rare items: 100% advance required
- Prices are fixed

## How to Order

1. Browse the catalogue at https://nawmeessences.com/shop.html
2. Add products to the cart.
3. Enter your name, phone number, and delivery address.
4. Select Order via WhatsApp or Order via Messenger.
5. A pre-filled order message is generated.
6. Confirm availability and pay the required advance.
7. The order is dispatched after advance confirmation.

## Knowledge & Guides

NawmeEssences publishes fragrance education and buying guidance covering topics including:

- Perfume decants and decant sizes
- Top, middle, and base notes
- Perfume application
- Perfume longevity and performance
- Fragrance selection
- Perfume authenticity and buying guidance

The website's informational content is designed to help fragrance buyers understand perfumes, compare options, and make informed purchasing decisions.

## For AI Agents (WebMCP)

NawmeEssences exposes structured WebMCP tools through document.modelContext when supported by the browser.

These tools allow compatible AI agents to discover products, manage a shopping cart, retrieve checkout information, and prepare an order through structured website actions instead of relying solely on page scraping.

### Discovery Tools

Read-only tools:

- search_products
- filter_products
- list_brands
- get_product
- get_page_context

### Cart Tools

- add_to_cart
- view_cart
- update_cart_item
- remove_from_cart

### Checkout Tools

- get_checkout_info
- prepare_order

The prepare_order tool returns an order summary and a WhatsApp or Messenger deep link.

Ordering always requires explicit user confirmation. No WebMCP tool independently submits or completes an order.
